notes: Phase E — the side-channels on SonosZone are gone. stationName, stationNameURI and stationLogoURL removed: station identity now lives only in PlaybackStore, bound to the URI it was resolved for. stationNameURI existed solely to detect staleness in stationName — a guard against a problem the field created. Four consumers moved; two of them were actively harmful. stationDisplay's raw fallback is what put 'hls.m3u8' and 'groovesalad-128-aac' on zone cards, and because it only fired when the resolve cache missed, it disguised a cache bug as a naming bug and cost real debugging time. contentDeclaration's raw synthesis read Sonos's dc:title, so it could only ever produce a name worse than no name. Also removed zone_state's code: it cached a station name and logo per zone, became write-only when phase D deleted its only reader, and has been written on every station play and transfer for nobody since; zone_last_playing supersedes it. The table itself is left in place — inert, and not worth a migration against real data. Transport optimism (steps 1-4) shipped in 0.0.60 remains dual-running pending soak. 22 reducer tests green throughout.
